name: slices
description: Change work sized to its situation, for AI-assisted coding — a change takes the posture and rigor it warrants, and most changes need none of these commands. Where writing it down pays: /slices:capture files one-concern, low-trust stubs the moment work is discovered; /slices:draft promotes a stub into a slice plan that re-verifies the capture's claims and ends in a review digest (shape + tension points); /slices:check hands the plan to a fresh-context adversary told only its path, and no drafted plan is implement-ready until it survives. Contract-first and rung-one by design: the artifacts stay stable as a repo hardens, so adopting the kit early never means migrating later.
